records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating revenues decreased 7.7% in 2024 compared to 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The prolonged weak freight market combined with the impact from certain fleet losses as a result of maintaining our pricing and operating margin discipline resulted in fewer tractors at the end of 2024.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We had available liquidity of $460 million, considering cash and cash equivalents on hand and available borrowing capacity of $419 million.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: While Dedicated customer retention rate and pipeline of opportunities remained strong throughout 2024, the first half of the year experienced a decline in the Dedicated fleet from isolated losses as a result of pricing discipline, followed by greater stability in the fleet during the second half of the year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: TTS had operating income of $75.2 million in 2024 compared to $169.3 million in 2023, and its operating margin percentage decreased to 3.5% in 2024 from 7.3% in 2023.
